chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Tha'laba ibn Maymun, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
Verily, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, loves the spreading of the greeting (salaam).

key_terms.إِفْشَاء: Spreading, proclamation, making public/open; not a private or hushed greeting but one offered openly and loudly
key_terms.السَّلَام: The greeting of peace; the Islamic greeting 'al-salaamu alaykum', also one of the Names of God

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir say about spreading the greeting of salaam?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) reports that God loves when believers spread the greeting of peace (salaam) openly and widely. This hadith is found in Chapter 7 on the Greeting in the section on social ethics in al-Kafi. The teaching encourages Muslims to greet one another freely and broadly, as doing so reflects a divine attribute and fosters communal bonds among believers.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba Bin Maymoun, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Loves the greeting (السَّلَامُ)’ offered openly (loudly).
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from Tha’Labah’ ibn Maymun from Muhammad ibn Qays from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, loves offering the greeting of peace openly, loud and clearly.”
